rule: fields not listed in scoring_rules implementation_agreement (SEs, p values, factor variances/SDs, alpha, percentages, chi-square differences, p of differences, CFI differences, Welch df): agree if |a-b| <= max(1e-3*max(|a|,|b|), 1e-6).
